# monotaur_maintenance_window (Resource)

Manages a one-off Monotaur maintenance window. For recurring maintenance use `monotaur_maintenance_schedule`, which generates its own windows. Attach the window to components with `monotaur_component.maintenance_window_ids`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_maintenance_window" "db_migration" {
  description               = "Database migration to the new cluster"
  start_date_time           = "2030-03-14T22:00:00+01:00"
  end_date_time             = "2030-03-15T02:00:00+01:00"
  reason                    = "ScheduledMaintenance"
  exclude_from_downtime     = true
  apply_to_component_status = true
  squelch                   = true
}

# Components own the window links.
resource "monotaur_component" "database" {
  name                   = "Database"
  maintenance_window_ids = [monotaur_maintenance_window.db_migration.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) A description of the maintenance (1 to 250 characters).
- `end_date_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the window ends. Must not be before `start_date_time`.
- `start_date_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the window starts, e.g. `2030-01-01T22:00:00Z`. The API stores it in UTC; any offset may be used and is kept as written while the instant is unchanged.

### Optional

- `apply_to_component_status` (Boolean) Whether the window's components show as under maintenance while it is active. Defaults to `false`.
- `exclude_from_downtime` (Boolean) Whether time inside the window is excluded from downtime in uptime reports. Defaults to `false`.
- `reason` (String) Why the maintenance happens: `ScheduledMaintenance` (the default), `EmergencyMaintenance`, `MonitoringIssue` or `ExternalIssue`.
- `squelch` (Boolean) Whether alarm notifications for the window's components are suppressed while it is active. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the window was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the maintenance window (assigned by the API).
- `maintenance_schedule_id` (String) The ID of the maintenance schedule the window is linked to, or null (read-only). Windows managed by this resource are normally one-off; it is cleared when the schedule is deleted.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the window was last updated (assigned by the API).
